notes: The image installs itself on the first start (AUTO_INSTALL, the variables in the official installation docs and internal/install/install_from_env.go of v2.0.3): it creates the SQLite database /data/answer.db and the administrator from ADMIN_EMAIL (the admin email you enter), ADMIN_PASSWORD (a generated password shown on the first-run card) and the username admin. Sign in with the email and that password. These variables are read only while the database is empty, so changing them later does nothing: change the password in your profile instead.

If the automatic installation ever fails (for example a value Answer refuses), the image falls back to its web installer at /install, which anyone who reaches the site could complete. The container log shows '[auto-install] try to init by env fail' in that case; fix the value and recreate the app before sharing the address.

One container with one named volume on /data, as in the official compose file: the SQLite database, config.yaml, uploaded files and the language packs all live there. SQLite (DB_TYPE=sqlite3) keeps the app to a single service; Answer also supports MySQL and PostgreSQL if a community outgrows it.

SITE_URL is the site's address and is stored in the database at installation. After a domain change, update it in Admin > Settings > General (Site URL), or links in emails and the sitemap keep the old address.

Outgoing email (registration confirmation, password reset, notifications) needs an SMTP server: set it in Admin > Settings > SMTP. Until then new members who register cannot confirm their address; the administrator created here is already active.
The memory floor is 384m: with 256m Answer sat at 150 to 166 MiB idle and reached 187 MiB while questions were asked and answered (59 to 73 % of the limit, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04).

The image's clock is fixed to Asia/Shanghai at build time (upstream TIMEZONE default); times in the web interface follow each user's own timezone setting, so this only affects timestamps in the container log.

Verified live on Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04 (RC-37): created from the 1-Click Recipes tab, Running in 17 to 32 s, installed by AUTO_INSTALL with no installer reachable, sign-in with the email, a question asked, answered and accepted and visible to a logged-out visitor, and a restart. Idle 144 to 183 MiB of 384m, peak 192 MiB; every image ref below is in its tested list.
